notes.title: Patch 0.4.2
notes.content: Bug fixes, visual upgrades, ghost-of-player-from-highscores upgrades.

notes.title: Patch Version 0.4.0
notes.content: New font! Plus streamlined beta for more of a vertical slice. UI updates, collectible coins/new collectibles added, ghost system refined, plenty of bugfixes, maybe more bugs introduced :O. Good dodging!

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 bugfixes
notes.content: Minor bugfixes, mainly being Mac fixes so the game runs on Mac.

notes.title: Update to 0.3, Map 3 released
notes.content: Hey everyone, similar to last update, we've got Map 3 with Easy and Medium versions out so it's "complete" except for any changes we'll be making from feedback on them. Good luck and happy dodging!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.7
notes.content: Leaderboards now tell you how many times someone was hit and has died, giving special colors to those who complete levels deathless or even hitless. Also minor bugfixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.6
notes.content: Added a map preview and some more legibility to the highscores in the level menu.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.5
notes.content: Fixes to the new character sprite and hitbox opacity sliders, shadows, and hitboxes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.4
notes.content: Added hitbox/character sprite opacity sliders, as well as saving them and volume slider's locally so you don't need to set them every time. Some UI changes as well.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3
notes.content: More trapdoor optimization (hopefully for good) and fixed options resolution menu to save preferences.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.content:
Improving trap door efficiency to reduce lag, thanks to Dominator088 in the Discord for pointing it out!

Also, added an FPS counter to help quantify any lag.

notes.title: patch 0.1.1
notes.content: Added a discord button so folks can provide direct feedback!

notes.title: Patch 0.1
notes.content: Initial beta build for testing. Have fun dodging!
